title: Weeks of hot deals are encouraging record Black Friday spending despite inflation concerns
summary: Black Friday produces more foot traffic at physical stores than any other day despite growing competition from e-commerce and brands rolling out steep holiday discounts online weeks in advance, according to retail technology company Sensormatic Solutions.

title: Los Angeles schools block Google's AI features, consider dropping tech giant's products
summary: The LA district, which enrolls half a million students, has made no formal announcement, and the move caught parents and students by surprise, said Bridie Lee, a leader of Schools Beyond Screens LA.

title: Army deems lead azide detonation a success but criticism lingers over notification
summary: So far, the EPA said there has continued to be "zero" airborne lead detected in the region since Wednesday's controlled detonation. While that's reassuring, residents and some elected officials have criticized the Army for not being more transparent and providing more notice when it first determined the stockpile was unstable.

title: Parts of the U.S. clean up, power outages being restored after Thanksgiving storm soaks East Coast
summary: The storms snarled travel and downed trees and power lines. The heavy weather led to water rescues from New York to Virginia.

title: NFL's Thanksgiving tripleheader has impressive comebacks and fantastic finishes
summary: Caleb Williams put the Chicago Bears in first place. Joe Milton III put a dagger in his former team's season. Tyler Bass put the Buffalo Bills in position for a No. 1 seed.

title: Protesters take to the streets in Puerto Rico's capital as standard of living deteriorates
summary: Retirees, university students, bus drivers and others joined the protest organized by some 30 groups ranging from unions to religious organizations. The crowds gathered in front of the largest mall in the Caribbean on Black Friday for what organizers dubbed the "Day of National Outrage."

title: Republicans rethink tariffs, giving Democrats an opening to challenge Trump
summary: After devastating election losses that centered on rising costs, many Republicans said they're open to reconsidering some of the levies that have become a central plank of Trump's global trade agenda.

title: Using a drone and a poop-sniffing dog, scientists perform health checks on endangered orcas
summary: In their search for their dwindling food source, the whales are spending less time in the Salish Sea, the maze of inland waters between Washington State and British Columbia.

title: A Ukraine loan is in limbo after EU budget talks stall. Leaders will try again
summary: The spending package is small compared to national budgets — around 1% to 1.2% of gross national income — but it encapsulates the ambitions of the world's biggest trading bloc and how it sees itself on the international stage.

title: Canada's Supreme Court largely upholds a Quebec ban on religious symbols for public servants
summary: The 2019 law, known as Bill 21, bans religious symbols — including Muslim headscarves, Sikh turbans, Jewish skullcaps and Christian crosses — for workers covered by it.

title: Mexico's government is slamming a DEA crime tip line as foreign interference. Others are thrilled.
summary: The announcement opened the latest chapter in an ongoing struggle between the U.S. and Mexican governments over who has the right to take action against cartels in Mexico.

title: Serbia's student movement proposes a chemistry professor for presidency ahead of Dec. 27 ballot
summary: The presidential vote comes after the student movement defeated former President Aleksandar Vucic's right-wing Serbian Progressive Party in an early parliamentary ballot on Oct. 25.

title: U.S. military says it disabled another ship that tried to breach naval blockade on Iranian ports
summary: A military aircraft fired "precision munitions" at the stern of the Palau-flagged M/V Pacific Archer on Thursday, and the "ship's propulsion was ultimately disabled and the civilian crew was unharmed," U.S. Central Command said in a statement.

title: Zelenskyy urges the U.S. to pressure Putin, calling Trump's 'my friend' remark strange
summary: "He can't be a friend," Zelenskyy told the BBC in Kyiv, likening it to someone calling Adolf Hitler a friend during World War II.
